paper_metadata.title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model designed to increase throughput for reasoning workloads while achieving state-of-the-art accuracy compared to similarly-sized models. Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 builds on the Nemotron-H architecture, in which the majority of the self-attention layers in the common Transformer architecture are replaced with Mamba-2 layers, to achieve improved inference speed when generating the long thinking traces needed for reasoning. We create Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 by first pre-training a 12-billion-parameter model (Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base) on 20 trillion tokens using an FP8 training recipe. After aligning Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base, we employ the Minitron strategy to compress and distill the model with the goal of enabling inference on up to 128k tokens on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU (22GiB of memory, bfloat16 precision). Compared to existing similarly-sized models (e.g., Qwen3-8B), we show that Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 achieves on-par or better accuracy on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to 6x higher inference throughput in reasoning settings like 8k input and 16k output tokens. We are releasing Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, Nemotron-Nano12B-v2-Base, and Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base checkpoints along with the majority of our pre- and post-training datasets on Hugging Face.

extraction_data.innovation: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer architecture combining state-space models with attention for efficient reasoning; three-phase curriculum-based data blending strategy for pre-training; high-quality synthetic SFT-style data generation using LLM prompting and majority voting to enhance mathematical and fundamental reasoning capabilities
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: Nemotron-CC classified web crawl data (crawl-medium, crawl-medium-high, crawl-high, syn-crawl-high), math, Wikipedia, code, academic data, crawl++, multilingual data, synthetic SFT-style data
extraction_data.application: Mathematical reasoning, code generation, multilingual understanding, general language tasks
extraction_data.research_problem: Building an accurate and efficient hybrid Mamba-Transformer reasoning model
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning on synthetic reasoning and general data
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Synthetic SFT-style data (general-sft, stem-sft, code-sft), Fundamental Reasoning SFT data
extraction_data.supported_language: Arabic, Danish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian
extraction_data.paper_title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Hybrid Mamba-Transformer (Mamba-2 layers replace most self-attention layers)
extraction_data.context_extension_method: Continuous pretraining (CPT) on 512k tokens with synthetic long-document QA data
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Three-phase curriculum pre-training (diversity -> high-quality -> reasoning-focused) followed by supervised fine-tuning
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Prompting DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3-30B to generate algebraic word problems and chain-of-thought processes, filtered via majority voting
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Qwen-based reward model for GRPO; rule-based verifier for IFEval; database state comparisons for WorkBench
extraction_data.tool_calling_format: Rule-based tool-call verification layer; multi-step verifiable tool-calling setup
